notApplicableToVertexPipeline.reason: This gate was authored for TRAIN-05's teacher/critic pipeline: a second model algorithmically re-scored each candidate (usable/canonical/decisive critic rates, N candidate slots per scenario), and minimumAverageScores' four category names (grounding/classification/riskCoverage/decisionSupportSafety) were defined against that pipeline's own review process. TA3's design has no separate critic-review step -- Vertex AI Gemini generates one thesis per case, reviewed directly by a human against rubrics/manual-review-v1.json's six differently-named dimensions (summaryCorrectness/bullBearBalance/riskQuality/inputAdherence/reviewerUtility/knowledgeLeakage), with no documented 1:1 mapping to the four names above. Retired for this pipeline shape, not evaluated as pass/fail -- kept in this file rather than deleted so a future critic-style step, if ever reintroduced, has its historical threshold on record.
